questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  wikijs:
    container_name: wikijs
    image: ghcr.io/requarks/wiki:2.5.317
    depends_on:
      - wikijs-db
    environment:
      DB_TYPE: postgres
      DB_HOST: wikijs-db
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_USER: wikijs
      DB_PASS: ${WIKI_JS_DB_PASS}
      DB_NAME: wiki
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:3000
  wikijs-db:
    container_name: wikijs-db
    image: postgres:11-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: wiki
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${WIKI_JS_DB_PASS}
      POSTGRES_USER: wikijs
    logging:
      driver: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
